text.en: Dog owners consistently highlight Dawn’s warm, patient, and knowledgeable approach during training classes. Reviewers note that she and her team create a friendly, encouraging environment where owners feel supported, answering questions thoroughly and tailoring guidance to each dog’s personality and temperament.

Clients appreciate Dawn’s attentive care when looking after pets for day care or overnight home boarding. Multiple reviewers mention that their dogs are eager to visit, settling in happily with regular playtime, while owners receive reassuring photo and video updates showing their pets relaxed and comfortable.

Owners report steady improvements in their dogs' focus, manners, and socialisation through positive training techniques. Many clients note that young pups and spirited dogs develop solid obedience skills in group classes, making daily walks and family routines significantly more enjoyable and manageable.

q.en: Does Auroara Dog Training offer home boarding for dogs?

a.en: Yes, home boarding and sitting services are provided, with regular photo and video updates sent to owners.

q.en: Are group training classes available for puppies?

a.en: Yes, the trainer runs group sessions focusing on foundation obedience and puppy socialisation.

q.en: Can owners book one-to-one coaching sessions?

a.en: Yes, private lessons and tailored behavioural consultations are offered alongside group classes.

q.en: Does the service accommodate dogs with separation anxiety?

a.en: Reviewers mention that anxious dogs settle well during visits and receive calm, individual attention.
